description: Eclipse Aperture — the Instagram adapter: one approved package becomes native Feed, Carousel, Story, and Reel variants for a professional account, with publishing and analytics only through Meta's sanctioned Graph API surface. v0.1 is a FORMALIZATION, not a second Instagram pipe: the house's existing sanctioned connector route is referenced, never duplicated — no token path, session handling, or credential material exists in this server, and it posts nothing. It codes the governed wrapper: a STATIC capability declaration fixture (dated, [verify]-flagged; PUBLISH_API publishing/drafts, READ_API reads, OWN_ENGAGEMENT_API own-media comments, COMMUNITY_PREP community engagement; grade A for eligible professional accounts subject to Meta app permissions, review, account role, and Graph API version) whose simulated probe failure downgrades modes exactly as the family core prescribes; native variant builders (Feed 4:5, Carousel in narrative order, Reel/Story 9:16 with safe zones, the working link path — profile link or Story sticker, caption links never treated as a conversion path, the platform AI-media label carried on the variant) with classified diffs vs canonical and per-variant hashes; and the preview pack the owner approves, binding exact hashes. Threads is a Meta sub-adapter inside this family tooling per spec SS8 — not a separate product, and no Threads claim is made.
